fact: The minister of digital transition told the finance committee in June 2024 that RESINA is a network owned by the Burkinabè state, that the Government has for some years been investing in its rehabilitation, and that the rehabilitation of RESINA is among the priority actions of PACTDIGITAL (2024-2028), whose whole cost of 150 million US dollars (92,752,319,800 FCFA) is financed by an IDA credit, no. 7462-BF, signed on 14 February 2024; the report does not name local governments among RESINA's sites.
title: Rapport n°2024-016/ALT/COMFIB, dossier n°099 relatif au projet de loi portant autorisation de ratification de l'accord de crédit n°7462-BF signé le 14 février 2024 à Ouagadougou entre le Burkina Faso et l'Association internationale de développement (IDA) pour le financement du Projet d'accélération de la transformation digitale du Burkina Faso (PACTDIGITAL)
publisher: Assemblée législative de transition, Commission des finances et du budget (COMFIB)
